answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 1341 Country: India Title: My best friend has given birth to a girl child.Wondering whether she could be named insha? Question: My best friend has given birth to a girl child.Wondering whether she could be named insha? Answer ID: 1341 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 813/813/J) It is narrated in hadith that you will be called on the Day of Judgment by your and your fathers? names; therefore keep good names. ( Mishkaat : 408) The name ? Insha? though pleasant in speaking and listening, but it is not so meaningful. ? Insha? means to create, to nourish, to start, to write, text, style of writing, etc. If your friend wishes she can keep this name but it is advisable to choose any name of Sahabiyat and Tabeyiyat or any good meaningful name for her daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
